exact_title: Clinical predictive artificial intelligence evaluation: A narrative review of trial designs and practical considerations
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom model has no dedicated atom kind for narrative-review recommendations, governance rules, or conceptual framework components; source-supported recommendations were represented primarily as author_conclusion and framework descriptions as other/method without inventing new atom kinds.
extraction_limitations: This publication is a narrative review rather than a primary experimental study. Atoms focus on the review authors’ own framework, definitions, recommendations, and appraisal-relevant synthesis; cited primary-study findings were not recast as if generated by this publication.
The authors describe source families consulted but do not report a systematic search strategy, study-selection flow, formal risk-of-bias assessment, or evidence-grading method.
Illustrative sepsis scenarios used to explain governance and causal methods were preserved as conceptual examples, not as empirical trial results.
No companion materials were specified for this task.
